title: Varsity Jacket Maker (2026)
verdict: The easiest varsity jacket maker in 2026 is Wooter's free design service. Tell its designers the colors, the letter or logo and the names you want, and they send back a mockup of a wool-body, leather-sleeve jacket for you to approve.
Jostens has an online builder for school letter jackets with a large patch catalog. RushOrderTees lets you add print or embroidery to stock letterman jackets.
steps_title: Make a varsity jacket in five decisions

steps.name: Body color
steps.text: Usually the main team or school color.

steps.name: Sleeves
steps.text: Leather in a contrasting color is the classic.

steps.name: Chest mark
steps.text: A letter, mascot or logo on the left chest.

steps.name: Names and numbers
steps.text: Name on the chest or back, year or number on the sleeve.

ranking.fit: Teams, schools, clubs and brands that want a jacket made to their own design.
ranking.lacks: Made to order, so allow several weeks. Ask for the current timeline before you plan around a date.
ranking.note: Wooter's jacket has a wool body, leather sleeves and fleece lining, with buttons or a zip.

ranking.fit: High school students who want a traditional letter jacket with school and activity patches.
ranking.lacks: A base jacket starts around $200 before patches, embroidery or leather sleeves.

ranking.fit: Groups that want a printed or embroidered logo on a stock letterman jacket, some with no minimum.
ranking.lacks: Stock jackets from brands like Sport-Tek and Augusta, decorated rather than made to your design.

why: A varsity jacket has five decisions in it: body color, sleeve color and material, closure, the chest mark, and what goes on the back and sleeves.
A good maker walks you through them in that order. Wooter does it with a designer in place of a form: you describe it, they draw it, you change it until it is right.
Sizes run youth extra small to adult 5XL, so one design can cover a whole team or a single graduate.

criteria.name: Real materials
criteria.text: Wool body and leather sleeves, or a lighter alternative.

criteria.name: One or many
criteria.text: A single jacket or a team order.

criteria.name: Proof
criteria.text: A mockup before it is made.

faq.q: Can I make just one varsity jacket?
faq.a: Ask Wooter for the minimum on jackets when you request the design. RushOrderTees has no minimum on printed stock jackets.

faq.q: What goes on a varsity jacket?
faq.a: A letter or logo on the left chest, a name on the right or the back, a graduation year or number on the sleeve.
Buttons, usually snaps, are traditional. A zip is warmer and quicker.

faq.q: Do I need a school to order one?
faq.a: No. Clubs, companies and brands order them too.

faq.q: How much does the design cost?
faq.a: Nothing at Wooter. The design service is free.
